ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in mottling and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling clustered at the distal margin of the left lobe; sparse white focal spots and linear streaks distributed across the central and outer regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65-70 degrees and a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes along the distal edges; notably deeper notches on the right lobe near the tip compared to the inner lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep along the trailing edge leading to distinct, pointed distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring visible on the distal margin of the left lobe and at the extreme apex of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast linear marks (rake-like scratches) breaking the dark pigmentation, primarily oriented diagonally across the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct bulbous, irregular protrusion on the terminal margin of the right fluke tip, representing significant structural deviation from the primary lobe contour.
other_distinctive_markers: A deep, irregular jagged notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, situated approximately 10% of the distance from the tip toward the median notch.
